## Lessons learned

- Start-Process npm Windows-on Unix shell scriptet talal elobb -> Win32 hiba. Fix: child PS wrapper.
- PowerShell Set-Location quote-interpolation apostrophe-s path-on elszall. Fix: -WorkingDirectory.
- Electron packaged dotenv csak dev-ben mukodik. Fix: userData .env kozvetlen parsolas.
- Flyway unique index elszall ha mar van duplikatum. Fix: DO block RAISE EXCEPTION pre-check.
- Tailwind max-h + overflow-hidden + fix min-h kivagja a footert. Fix: shrink-0 + content overflow-y-auto.
- V104 Flyway szam mar foglalt volt (V104_daily_checklist). Fix: V155-re atszamozas.
- AI review bot kommenteket tomeggyujtes: for pr in ...; do gh api /pulls/N/reviews; done.
